identity_cert_path.description: Path to the server's X.509 certificate file.

identity_key_path.description: Path to the server's private key file.

cacert_dir.description: Directory containing CA certificates for validation.

ca_cert_path.description: Path to the primary CA certificate (optional; often auto-resolved via cacert_dir).

ca_revocation_list_path.description: Path to the CA certificate revocation list (CRL); auto-resolved in most cases.

listen_address.description: IP address the server binds to (e.g., '127.0.0.1' or '::' for IPv6).

listen_port.description: TCP port number for incoming MyProxy connections.

credential_lifetime_hours.description: Default credential lifetime in hours (max 168 = 7 days).

renewal_threshold_hours.description: Minimum remaining lifetime (in hours) before credential renewal is required.

authorized_users.description: List of allowed username patterns (Unix shell globs accepted).

authorized_groups.description: List of allowed Unix group names or patterns.

log_file.description: Path to the log file (empty string disables file logging).

require_proxy_cert.description: Require clients to present a valid proxy certificate (not just end-entity cert).

enforce_renewal.description: Enforce credential renewal within the threshold (deny access if expired).

working_dir.description: Directory for temporary files and credential storage.

enable_gridftp.description: Enable optional GridFTP data channel support.

gridftp_port.description: Base port for GridFTP data connections (if enabled).

num_threads.description: Number of worker threads for handling concurrent requests.

allowed_vos.description: List of allowed Virtual Organizations (VOs). Each entry specifies a VO name and optionally its Distinguished Name (DN).

dn.description: Optional VO's CA Distinguished Name (e.g., '/O=Grid/OU=CERN/CN=CERN Grid CA').

max_credentials_per_user.description: Maximum number of credentials a single user may store at once.

cleanup_interval_seconds.description: Interval (in seconds) between credential cleanup runs.
